capabilities: Display a monthly calendar with Gregorian and lunar dates, holidays, workday adjustments and solar terms
Mark notes on the calendar by creation and modification date
Create daily, weekly, monthly, quarterly and yearly notes
Apply Templater templates when creating notes
Configure title formats, folders and scan directory per note type
extras: Not yet listed in the community plugin market (under review); install manually from GitHub releases. Mobile support and Tasks plugin integration are listed as planned, not implemented.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in calendar view, and nothing that places vault notes on a date grid alongside Chinese lunar dates, holidays and solar terms.

relations.evidence: Integrates with the Templater plugin to auto-apply templates when creating notes.

summary: Monthly calendar that shows lunar dates, holidays, workday adjustments and solar terms, and links or creates notes for each date.
